messages:
Maya: Kicking off ap-east1 edge bring-up now — target is to stand up 4 GPU pools (a10g x2, a100x2), networking, and the public egress NAT. Sharing a quick-pass validation runbook below. Please review and call out gaps.

Raj: Thanks — do we have a capacity plan (perm orders) or is it on-demand till commit? :thinking:

Maya: For this rollout it's hybrid: initial spot-backed capacity for smoke, then convert 2 nodes per pool to reserved (commit) before handoff. I put numbers at bottom.

Li: Dropping the quick-pass tests. These are minimal, fast checks to certify readiness for handoff to oncall & customers.

ops-bot: Deploy job started: `infra/edge/ap-east1/bootstrap v2.3.4` — logs at https://ci.redwood.internal/build/2345

Maya: Quick-pass checklist (run in order):
1) Bootstrap infra: subnet, route tables, NAT, VPC endpoints.
2) Provision GPU node pools (labels: pool=gpu-edge, zone=ap-east1).
3) Register nodes to fleet + taint management.
4) Deploy runtime (inference-runtime:stable) to pools.
5) Run health probes & smoke queries.
6) Verify metrics & SLO gates.
7) Final sanity: failover & cross-region fallback.

Sam: Inline commands I ran for #2-4:
```bash
# node pool create (example)
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: gpu-edge-a10g
spec:
  count: 4
  gpu: a10g
EOF
```

Alex: For runtime deploy we use the rollout job: `deploy/runtime/ap-east1-edge` — add `--strategy=canary:10%` for safety.

Li: Health probes (run after deploy):
- k8s node status: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-edge -o wide` -> all Ready
- runtime readiness: `curl -sS http://<runtime-pod>:8080/health` -> JSON {"status":"ok","gpu_ok":true}
- KV cache warming: send tokenized prompt workload (see snippet)

Maya: Smoke query snippet (small, N=3 concurrent):
```bash
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -sS -X POST http://api.ap-east1.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-v1-edge","prompt":"Hello world","max_tokens":16}' \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" &
done
wait
```
Expect all responses within latency SLOs (p50 < 40ms, p95 < 130ms for local edge).

Raj: What are the exact SLO gates we want to pass before handoff?

Maya: Gate thresholds (must pass for 30m window):
- Node health: 100% Ready, no CrashLoopBackOff.
- Runtime error rate: < 0.5% 5xx.
- Latency: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 130ms, p99 < 380ms for small completion (<=32 tokens).
- GPU utilization: steady-state 10-40% for smoke (ensures room for load).
- Disk & network egress: bursts capped under quota (see billing limits).
- KV cache hit-rate: >= 60% on repeated prefix runs.

Sam: Ran a 20-min smoke run. Results: p50=34ms, p95=120ms, 5xx=0.2%, KV hit ~65%. Node count stable. Posting condensed logs.

Alex: Nice. Did you also exercise fallback to regional pool (sfo2) if a node pool is tainted? We need to test automated routing policy.

Sam: Yes — tainted one node pool and observed traffic shift to sfo2 with ~200ms extra tail latency — accepted.

ops-bot: Metric alert rule check: `edge-ap-east1-runtime-errors` not firing. Next scheduled check in 5m.

Li: Networking checks quick list:
- NAT egress connectivity to telemetry endpoints.
- Private S3 endpoints accessible for model blobs.
- BGP/route propagation verified (prop delay < 30s).
- Firewall rules: control-plane CIDR whitelisted for on-prem replication.

Maya: Cost note: initial spot-backed smoke pool cost ~0.42 USD/GPU-hour on average. After converting 2 nodes to reserved, estimate ~0.63 USD/GPU-hour effective amortized. Flagging finance for obvious delta.

Raj: For handoff doc what do we include? Ops runbook + SLO dashboard links + escalation path.

Maya: Handoff checklist (minimum):
- Link to SLO dashboard (dashboards/ap-east1-edge).
- Runbook: `runbooks/edge/ap-east1-failure.md` (steps for node reprovision, model rollback).
- Oncall rotation updated and primary/secondary assigned.
- Billing alert thresholds set (daily cap).
- Customer-impact test: send a request from prod-sim user and verify response path.

Alex: I'll own the runbook update and add a short playbook for model rollbacks.

Maya: Next steps:
- Sam: push the reserved conversion for 2 nodes/pool once we sign off.
- Raj: validate billing alerts with finance.
- Li: run full networking sweep (10 checks) and post results.
- Alex: update runbook and create one-button rollback doc.
- Maya: schedule 30-min readiness review with oncall + customer success (T+2 hours).

Sam: Completed reserved conversion in staging. Will run prod after signoff.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: readiness-review in 2 hours @channel

Maya: Quick risk notes:
- If KV cache warm-up fails, cold-start token cost will spike ~4x. Plan: pre-warm prefix set of high-volume keys.
- Watch cross-region egress — customers in APAC may see billing increases if fallback to SFO happens often.

Raj: LGTM. I'll validate quotas and post final OK in this thread before the review.

Maya: Thanks everyone — dropping a concise summary in 15m and closing the bring-up thread after the review. :white_check_mark:
